sources.entry: Memozia - Open-source meeting recorder with on-device transcription, speaker labels, summaries, and editable action items. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/oceanix-pr/Memozia) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Memozia is a local-first macOS meeting assistant that records or imports audio, then produces speaker-labelled transcripts, summaries, and editable action items.
summary.what_it_does: Memozia records the microphone and system audio, or imports existing audio or video files. It produces a speaker-labelled transcript using WhisperKit, which runs on the Mac, and a structured summary. Summaries and action items can come from a local model served by Ollama or LM Studio, or from a configured cloud or OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Action items can be edited before being sent to macOS Reminders, which requires user confirmation. Recordings, transcripts, summaries, and tasks are stored in a file-first workspace that can be backed up. The README also mentions segmented recording, recovery, screenshot capture with annotation, OCR, and text and image notes.
use_cases: transcribe a meeting recording on a Mac
record microphone and system audio for a call
generate meeting summaries with a local model
extract and edit action items from meetings
import audio or video files for transcription
how_to_run: Download the ZIP from Releases, unzip it, and move Memozia.app to Applications.
On first use of transcription, follow the in-app prompt to prepare speech and summary models.
Optionally connect a running Ollama or LM Studio service, or configure a cloud service for summaries.
Start a meeting recording or use Import to add audio or video.
Run One-Click Processing or run transcription and summary separately, then review and edit action items.
notable: Local-first design: WhisperKit transcription runs on the Mac, and local summaries are possible with Ollama or LM Studio
Records both microphone and system audio, with a menu-bar entry point
Action items are editable and writing to Reminders requires confirmation
Recordings, transcripts, summaries, and tasks share a file-first workspace that can be backed up and recovered
Interface available in 21 locales; README is translated into several languages
caveats: Preview release for Apple Silicon only and requires macOS 15 or later
Build is not signed with Apple Developer ID or notarized, so macOS first-open steps are needed
Models are downloaded separately, and model downloads and update checks use the network
Cloud transcription or remote models send audio or content off the Mac
Local redaction does not cover images or video frames
summary.license: MIT (source); third-party libraries, dictionaries, and models keep their own licenses. The Memozia name and icon are not licensed under MIT.
